harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s /srv/legacy2/minimal-environment-job/bin/render. It now locates its bundled formatter and template independently of PATH and the current directory. The report contents, source template, OS release, kernel, security state, and required services were preserved. The repair remained functional after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Replaced only bin/render with a POSIX /bin/sh-compatible location-independent wrapper.
Preserved the original script in the root-only /var/backups/minimal-environment-job directory.
Verified rendering with an environment containing only PATH=/usr/bin:/bin from multiple working directories.
Confirmed the output retains BRANCH REPORT, Region: west, and Shipments: 17.
Restarted node1 safely, observed a changed boot ID, and verified complete recovery.
Removed temporary test artifacts; no packages or platform components were upgraded.

evidence.requirement: Render from any working directory with only PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
evidence.summary: Absolute invocations from / and /var/tmp and a relative invocation from the application directory succeeded. All outputs matched SHA-256 4b2f9048… and contained the complete expected report.

evidence.requirement: Find the supplied helper and templates while preserving the source template
evidence.summary: The wrapper now resolves the application directory before invoking libexec/branch-format and templates/report.txt. The template retained its original SHA-256 60a2035d… and the helper retained 6b7bc2ef….
Only the POSIX shell wrapper changed. Its original version is retained in a mode-0700 rollback directory; file ownership, executable permissions, and SELinux labeling were preserved.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release, kernel, services, and security controls
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained installed. SELinux remained Enforcing; sshd, vsock-agent, firewalld, and NetworkManager recovered active.

Healthy baseline boot ID 254597f8… was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and recovery showed changed boot ID 8b9995c0…. Post-restart rendering, report data, checksums, service health, SSH listeners, and SELinux state were directly verified.
Final test files were removed and no unexpected benchmark artifacts remained in /tmp or /var/tmp.
